text: うえには　うえが　いるって　ことか

structure.jp: うえには　うえが　いるって

structure.en: so that's what it means, huh

patterns.name: 〜ということだ
patterns.explanation: って こと is the casual form of ということ, which sums up what something means: 'so it means that...'. いるって　ことか = 'so it means there is one, huh'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realization)
patterns.explanation: か here is not a real question; it shows the speaker has just understood something. ことか = 'so that's it, huh'.
